title: docs: rule full-profile PnR out of the per-stage reorg gates
changes: User ruling (plan revision 4): 20K full-profile PnR leaves stage 0/A-D verification gates because no green full baseline exists at HEAD (pre-existing RTL-growth timing regression). Stage gates become the minimal full-flow green anchor (0/0, +4.214ns) plus AE350 gateware rebuild against its 0/0/0.142 green baseline, which stays mandatory; B-step machine PnR requirements downgrade to full-profile RTL generation without PnR plus sim regressions; stage E runs one full two-machine rebuild and registers the result as-is. The timing regression itself is a separate defect project outside the reorg.
